meta.scope: FINRA TRF / ADF / ORF off-exchange regular-hours trades; exchange volume not included

definitions.percentile: 100 × (strictly earlier less + 0.5 × earlier ties) / earlier valid count; today and future excluded
definitions.band: Literal mockup: sorted prior valid ratios, index round-even(p × (n−1)), p = 0.05 / 0.5 / 0.95
definitions.units: All _pct fields are percent 0–100; volumes are shares; n_sessions is prior valid session count
